question: Does the actual output of a competing route trigger exactly one arithmetic click and retain a record in a receiver prepared in its waiting state?
scope: One central source only. The receiver waiting state is prepared at t=0; this does not test an autonomous first signal writing a waiting state or an internally computed uniqueness approval.
prior_evidence: OR/NO bare-route competition passed fresh lengths8 and10 at input(0,1). Both isolated length8 outlets first receive the paired input(+1,-1) atstep12. Higher-C_pair preference remains refuted; no input-controlled winner flip was found.

preparation.source: The sole central source has channel0=(0,1,2), channel14=(0,-1,2). Source-absent controls set only those initial counters to zero.
preparation.guide: PairedArm length7: pattern pairs at sites2,3, ordinaryO elsewhere; all apparatus counterszero.
preparation.receiver: A generic Receiver adjacent to each included arm atdistance8, channel0=(0,0,4), channel14=(0,0,2). Its entire48-channel node is observed.
preparation.cases: Each joint pair with source present and absent:8. Each pattern isolated in each direction with source present and absent:8. Total16.

observations.C: Existing guarded arithmetic event: ell=after.b+before.a is nonzero and the complete triple changes. Retain every event on all48 receiver channels; C_node banks only their shared update index.
observations.isolated_and_winner_success: Exactly one C_node time in the entire1..48 interval, lying in12..15. At that event the remainder pair becomes(0,0) and remains(0,0) throughstep48. The first event is caused by nonzero actual incoming source-derived input.
observations.loser_success: Every one of the48 complete receiver(a,b,r) triples equals the matching null baseline at every state1..48, with no C.
observations.null_success: The complete source-absent board is stationary.
observations.incoming_evidence: Retain the six signed input terms for every observed receiver channel at every completed old state, plus exact input sums, quotients and complete before/after states.
observations.no_erasure: Complete board states and inverses are preserved, including influences outside both receivers.

acceptance.required: All four source-present isolated pattern/direction cases satisfy isolated_and_winner_success. Both source-present mixed joint cases have the OR receiver satisfy isolated_and_winner_success and the NO receiver satisfy loser_success. All eight source-absent cases are stationary.
acceptance.ties: OR/OR andNO/NO source-present cases are diagnostic; no exclusive winner is predicted for ties.
acceptance.failure: Any required case fails: the joined single-click retaining component is not established. Report exactly which timing, extra-click, retention or leakage criterion failed.
acceptance.no_posthoc_relaxation: Do not shorten the observation window, ignore channels, replace C with an R event, or call multiple clicks one result after seeing data.

budget.exhaustion: Stop and preserve the incomplete prefix. No further search follows this bounded iteration.

publication_limits: Even a pass establishes only finite route-driven readout of an initially prepared waiting receiver. It would not establish autonomous waiting-state writing, internally computed unique-path confirmation, higher-complexity preference, physical light, quantum collapse or an irreversible microscopic time.
